title: Range validation made exclusive at both bounds
symptom: TelemetryValidationError: humidity value 100 is outside the allowed range [0, 100]
error_signature: TelemetryValidationError: humidity value 100 is outside the allowed range [0, 100]
root_cause: assertInRange() uses <= and >= instead of < and >, so values exactly on the documented inclusive bounds (e.g. humidity 100) are rejected.
